text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't catch up... not even a bit! At 
this rate, how could I ever be a hero...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ugh, uuuu...! I should have... uuugh...!
choice_data_list:
If you feel that frustrated, you'll only 
grow stronger.
Are you giving up on being a hero?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Trainer... Can I really get 
stronger...?
choice_data_list:
Feel as frustrated as you want, and let it 
fuel you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see... Then yeah... These feelings 
aren't wrong after all—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh...! Next time, I'm definitely not 
gonna loseee!!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...No! I don't want to give up! I am 
definitely going to become a hero!"
choice_data_list: Well then, let's keep giving it our all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah! That's right! There's no 
time to feel down, Justice Biko!!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I didn't come close at all today... That's 
why I have to work harder than ever 
before!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... alright! Now that it's decided, I 
gotta get to special training right away!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer! A hero doesn't have 
time to stand still!
